8	head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:576 — Fence regression (classifier on vs. off): `_bdb_hd_scan_body` keeps a body segment only when its first word is a fence verb, so a destructive command behind a shell keyword (`if true; then rm -rf src; fi`, `for d in src; do rm -rf $d; done`, `while :; do …`, `case … ) rm -rf src;;`, `f() { rm -rf src; }; f`, `else rm …`) is dropped entirely instead of forcing a full scan.
